name: WEB-T Translator (for TMGMT)
description: A TMGMT translator plugin for WEB-T / EU eTranslation.
project_description:
TMGMT implementation of WEB-T: The free Multilingual Automated Translation Solution by the European Commission.

 See here for more information about the free multi-language Website translation tool

 Features 
 Free translation tool by the European Commission for these supported languages:

 Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, German, Greek, English, Spanish, Estonian, Finnish, French, Irish, Croatian, Hungarian, Icelandic, Italian, Japanese, Lithuanian, Latvian, Maltese, Norwegian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Chinese

 Post-Installation 
 You need to get a free API key from the European Commission: Get API Key 

 And dont forget to allow access to the callback-urls .

 Additional Requirements 
 We use translation service of WEB-T module.

 Similar projects 
 The module provided by EC is WEB-T . The module has its own translation logic. We want to offer the option of having translations done on the basis of TMGMT with Web-T as provider.

 There is also a similar module TMGMT Translator for eTranslation . During our research, we did not find this module and therefore developed this module and AI-provider-WEB-T on the basis of the existing WEB-T module. We use the settings and the translation service of the WEB-T module. We also use the data handling of the WEB-T module, which, among other things, ensures that only the translatable parts of an HTML text are transferred and translated.
